subject: Medexa: Isolation & ops alignment — next steps and artifacts
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samar Ali <samar.ali@medexa.com>, Priya Khatri <priya.k@medexa.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 15:15:00 -0700
Subject: Medexa: Isolation & ops alignment — next steps and artifacts

Thanks for your time today — quick summary and the artifacts we promised.

Key pain points you reiterated:
- PHI ingestion must remain in US-only regions; Medexa legal requires physical separation or strongly enforced VPC tenancy for inference.
- No outbound internet egress from the inference environment except to approved S3 endpoints and customer-managed monitoring.
- NetOps will need a clear flow diagram (what sits in customer VPC vs. Redwood-managed compute), firewall rules, and expected CIDR ranges for allowlist.
- KMS integration for envelope encryption + key rotations; Medexa will bring their KMS but wants Redwood to support external CMKs.
- SOC 2 + system logs: they need a checklist and timeline for audit evidence.

Stated goals from the call:
1) Pilot (sandbox, limited PHI subset) in ~6 weeks to validate connectivity and latency at ~50 QPS.
2) Production rollout in ~3 months after SOW and security sign-off.
3) Decision point on air-gapped (on-premised appliance) vs. VPC-with-strict-egress — Medexa prefers VPC if we can guarantee no uncontrolled egress.

What we (Redwood) will deliver by EOD Friday:
- Network diagram stub (attached: medexa-network-diagram.pdf) showing proposed placement and peering model.
- SOC 2 summary and evidence map (attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf).
- SOW template and a rough cost estimate for both VPC and air-gapped options (attached: redwood-sow-template.docx).

Immediate asks from Medexa (action owners in parentheses):
- Confirm whether Medexa NetOps can accept egress to a small set of managed S3 endpoints vs. requiring 0 egress (Samar).
- Share your current KMS provider and whether bringing a customer-managed key (CMK) is required for the pilot (Priya).

Next proposed step: Technical deep-dive with Medexa NetOps + Redwood Infra (Priyom + Lauren) — 60 minutes. Please share 2 windows for next week and preferred time zone.

Thanks again — I’ll circulate the diagram and SOC summary now.

— Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: medexa-network-diagram.pdf (diagram stub), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (summary), redwood-sow-template.docx (SOW template)

From: Samar Ali <samar.ali@medexa.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Khatri <priya.k@medexa.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Medexa: Isolation & ops alignment — next steps and artifacts

Marcus — thanks, very helpful summary. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- NetOps is open to a small set of managed egress endpoints but will require explicit FQDN/CIDR for each service and an approval window. We need that list before we can open firewall rules.
- For the pilot we prefer to keep keys in our KMS; yes, we will supply an external CMK if you support that model. Can Redwood outline the steps for key import and rotation policy compatibility?
- On air-gap vs VPC: our security committee will decide, but leaning toward VPC + strict egress to limit operational complexity. If you can show proof (logs + attestations) that no uncontrolled egress occurs, that strengthens our case.

Can you also confirm what data retention options Redwood supports for inference logs (retain for 30/90/365 days or configurable)? We'll need that for the compliance sheet.

We can do the technical deep-dive next Tue (May 26) 11am–12pm ET or Wed (May 27) 2pm–3pm ET. Please pick a slot.

Best,
Samar
Head of IT Operations — Medexa Health
samar.ali@medexa.com

Quick internal note + proposed owner assignments before the deep-dive: 

- Net topology & firewall allowlist: Priyom to produce a CIDR/FQDN proposal and an AWS peering/Transit Gateway sketch by Mon 5/25 (owner: Priyom).
- KMS onboarding doc: Lauren to draft steps for provisioning an external CMK and rotation policy compatibility by Tue 5/26 (owner: Lauren).
- Retention & logging options: Marcus to summarize supported retention windows and where audit logs live (S3 vs. CloudWatch export) and how we surface them for compliance.
- Cost delta for air-gapped vs VPC: I'll run a fast cost sketch to show the delta + ops lift and attach to the SOW draft.

I'll book Tue May 26 11am–12pm ET (Samar's first choice) for the technical deep-dive and invite NetOps + Infra. Marcus/ Lauren — please confirm availability and any additional artifacts you want in advance.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to pilot.

— Priyom
